name: GAT (Graph Attention)
tagline: Multi-head self-attention over graph neighbors: each edge weight is a softmax over LeakyReLU-scored source/destination feature projections.
diff_from_baseline: Velickovic et al., 'Graph Attention Networks' (ICLR 2018). Default attention-based GNN baseline; widely used as a Planetoid reference.

name: GCN
tagline: Symmetric-normalized graph convolution: each node's update is a degree-scaled mean of self-and-neighbor projected features.
diff_from_baseline: Kipf & Welling, 'Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks' (ICLR 2017). Canonical first-order spectral GCN baseline for Planetoid citation networks.

name: GraphSAGE (mean)
tagline: Inductive GNN: aggregate neighbors with mean, concatenate self/neighbor projections, and L2-normalize the resulting embedding.
diff_from_baseline: Hamilton et al., 'Inductive Representation Learning on Large Graphs' (NeurIPS 2017). Standard mean-aggregator SAGE; uses separate weights for self vs. neighbor features and L2 normalization.

name: GPS (Graph Transformer)
tagline: Each layer combines a local GCN-style MPNN with global multi-head self-attention, plus a residual FFN, following the GPS recipe.

key_hyperparams.name: lr / wd
key_hyperparams.role: tuned for transformer stability on Planetoid

diff_from_baseline: Rampasek et al., 'Recipe for a General, Powerful, Scalable Graph Transformer' (NeurIPS 2022). Hybrid MPNN+Transformer block; here used without positional/structural encodings.

name: NAGphormer
tagline: Hop2Token: build per-node sequences of K-hop normalized aggregations, then run a Transformer with attention-readout over hop tokens.
formula: $$\text{tokens}_i = [h_i^{(0)}, h_i^{(1)}, \dots, h_i^{(K)}],\quad h^{(k)} = (\tilde D^{-1/2}\tilde A\tilde D^{-1/2})^k W x;\quad z_i = \sum_k \mathrm{softmax}(a^\top T_i)_k\,T_i^k$$
pseudocode:
1. Project $x \to W x$; build hop tokens $T_i \in \mathbb{R}^{(K+1)\times D}$ via repeated GCN-norm propagation.
2. Add learnable hop-type embedding; LayerNorm + dropout.
3. Apply a Transformer encoder (8 heads, GELU, FFN=2D, norm-first) over each node's token sequence.
4. Compute attention weights $a^\top T_i$, softmax over hops, and read out $z_i = \sum_k w_{ik} T_i^k$.
5. MLP classifier on $z_i$.
diff_from_baseline: Chen et al., 'NAGphormer: A Tokenized Graph Transformer for Node Classification in Large Graphs' (ICLR 2023). Replaces direct message passing with multi-hop tokenization plus Transformer encoder.
